## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## 💡 Motivation & Use Case

## 📐 Proposed Architectural Outline

- **Target Platform**: [e.g. NVIDIA Jetson, Intel RealSense, CUDA Desktop]
- **Expected Inputs & Outputs**: [e.g. `(B, 3, 224, 224)` -> `(B, 1, 224, 224)` continuous metric depth]

## 🛠️ Proposed Implementation Approach
Outline the planned changes across `src/` modules.

## ➕ Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or reference papers here.
